responsibility: This file implements the Windows-specific support routines used by libgccjit internals. It formats and prints Win32 API failures, obtains the current user SID, creates ACL-restricted directories accessible only to that user, and provides a win_mkdtemp analogue that safely chooses a temporary parent directory and creates a randomized libgccjit subdirectory. Its responsibility is host-platform plumbing for secure tempdir creation and error reporting on Windows, complementing the generic tempdir and result code.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-w32.h, which only declares the Windows helpers, this same-stem .c file contains their Win32-specific implementations: formatting last-error messages, obtaining the current user SID, creating ACL-restricted directories, and providing the secure win_mkdtemp routine used by libgccjit on Windows.
